title: Time of "sensor expired" is only for English speakers ok
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3615
Originally posted by **Lutz9357** August 6, 2024 Please add a new function to Xdrip+. I haven't the possibility to change the time format In "sensor expired at" from PM and AM into 24 hour format. I read now (in german) "Sensor endet um 8.30 PM" - In future please "Sensor endet um 20.30 Uhr" The english time format is confusing for me.

comments.body: This isn't an "English" issue. My phone is set to 24h clock and I would prefer xDrip to honour this setting.

I would really like to see this change in future xdrip.

No longer messing up a sensor change by 12 hours, because stumbling once again over the 12hr/24hr AM/PM diff between english and non-english users would be an strong improvement.

@wirbel-at-vdr-portal 
It is on my todo list.  Although, I am not sure how easy it will be.  
I have open submissions that have not been reviewed yet.  I don't want to flood the repository with submissions.
It will be done if possible when we get to it.

Edit: I don't think my PR works for a follower.  It only works for a collector.  I will need to fix that.  I will update when I fix it.  
  
---  
  
I have a PR that fixes this: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/4131 

It will be good if you can test it.
The following is a test release.  You can install it in parallel with your existing xDrip.
It is a good idea to create a backup first though: https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/Backup-Database.html 

There is no need to set it up to get readings directly from your sensor.  You can set it up as an xDrip Sync follower to get readings from your existing xDrip on a test phone or on the same phone: https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/xDripSync.html

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1iz4cTqnJGgp3wvcmTT-jS-rESGLT5hUh/view?usp=sharing

@wirbel-at-vdr-portal I am sorry about your loss.  You can unsubscribe from this issue so that you won't receive a notification every time someone posts in it.
You have now posted in the associated PR.  As a result, you will also receive a notification every time there is a post in that PR.  Again, you can unsubscribe.

This is fixed as of the 2025.12.10 release.  xDrip will follow your Android setting for the 24-hour format.  If you have enabled that setting in Android, xDrip will show the sensor expiry note in that format.

Please let us know if you still experience the problem.
